test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. C sits to the immediate left of E. F is an immediate neighbour of A and C. D is not an immediate neighbour of E. What is the position of D with respect to F?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) C sits to the immediate left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cd2d75bcc3e9a31f7c19121669ce8d1e3ba7a0cf0664289c16859d8a276727a.png] 

2) F is an immediate neighbour of A and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70c9b6a047e34c6e99024ca8bef06e96031261a11eaf9def861076a2c333976a.png] 

3) D is not an immediate neighbour of E.

After positioning D only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc891957dfd95058777e6d23a05a3649747349bc2125cfbe49dce471b45cf451.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, D sits second to the left F.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
